description: Advances: ancora.tasks. Ancora.Gate.Preflight.corpus/1 at lib/ancora/gate/preflight.ex:57-62 hardcodes File.dir?(root <> "/.spec") regardless of --spec-dir, so a project whose specs live only under docs/spec cannot start a gate run without an empty decoy .spec/ present. Found by the ancora-xla.3 verifier and auditor on 2026-09-03. Full body follows in an update.
title: Preflight ignores the configured spec dir: a gate run cannot start without an empty .spec/ present
